name: match-statement-static-patterns-test-4828836871/static-match-patterns-semantics-e.bal
spec_references: Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
reason: The case requires semantic analysis of mapping match patterns, including their inability to match an object and an invalid computed key. Mapping match patterns are outside the explicitly supported const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern forms, so the whole case is a feature gap even though rejection of a nonconstant simple-variable pattern is within the supported constant-pattern area.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping match patterns {var1: 12} against an object
test_design_notes: Negative semantic test with @error annotations; illegal code alone does not imply an unsupported feature.
The simple-variable pattern a is marked invalid, but the mapping-pattern portion independently determines the whole-case classification.
